selection.name: learning_rate by final exact loss of gpsr_exact on selection_seed

description: E8 / paper Fig. 7, partial RED-tier run: Clements mesh at Haar init, random quadratic NN observable with 3 squaring hidden layers, biases and a linear read-out (PNP order 8), rescaled to unit standard deviation under the maximally mixed state (assumption), GPSR with R=8 and 10,000 shots per shifted loss, 100 iterations. Reduced from the paper's M=20, n=10 and M=26, n=13 to M=8, n=4 (paper scale needs a 2e7-dimensional state per evaluation).
